title: ConversationEvent
description: One event of the discussion gateway's conversation event stream, GET /api/v1/discussions/{crew}/events, sent as the data of a server-sent event. A conversation_updated event says a conversation has something new (a late answer, a scheduled reminder or follow-up); it carries no content, and the client fetches the conversation to read it. A caller receives events only for conversations they own. Each conversation_updated event carries an SSE id, the sequence of the discussion stream message it came from, that a client sends back as Last-Event-ID to resume.

type.description: connected is sent once the stream is open; heartbeat keeps an idle connection alive.

conversationId.description: The conversation that has something new, on conversation_updated.

reason.description: What is new, on conversation_updated: answer is a synthesis (a late answer), reminder is a scheduled reminder that fired, followup is a scheduled follow-up that reopened the conversation or started a turn.

threadId.description: The thread the news came on, on conversation_updated.

at.description: When the message was published, RFC 3339 in UTC, on conversation_updated.
